headline: Argentine household loan arrears fall to 12.2% in September
summary: The Central Bank of Argentina reported that non-performing loan ratios for household debt decreased to 12.2% in September, while overall private sector loan irregularity dropped to 7.5% amid an increase in debt refinancings.
why: Monitoring bank delinquency rates is key to assessing consumer debt health and financial stability during Argentina's ongoing economic stabilization plan.

entities.name: Banco Central de la República Argentina

impacts.name: Argentine Banking Sector
impacts.why: Successive monthly declines in household arrears relieve asset quality pressures across commercial banks.
